Kelivo 需要读取您选择的健康数据，以便生成健康活动摘要。摘要可能会发送给您选择的 AI 服务以生成回答。 / Kelivo needs to read the health data you choose so it can build an activity summary. That summary may be sent to the AI provider you selected to generate answers.
Kelivo 不会写入健康数据。此说明仅用于满足系统对 HealthKit 的要求。 / Kelivo does not write health data. This description is required by HealthKit.

Kelivo 可按您的选择使用定位提供天气或位置工具（工具定位可能发送给您选择的 AI 服务），也可在您开启辅助保活后，用低精度定位维持当前后台任务；保活坐标不会保存或发送。 / Kelivo uses location for location and weather tools you request (tool coordinates may be sent to your chosen AI provider), or coarse location to support current background tasks when you enable that option. Keep-alive coordinates are not stored or transmitted.

仅当您开启定位辅助保活且有后台任务时，Kelivo 使用低精度定位辅助执行，不保存或发送坐标。 / When you enable location-assisted execution, Kelivo uses coarse location only during current background tasks. These coordinates are not stored or transmitted.

Kelivo 需要访问提醒事项，以便在您确认后查询、创建和完成提醒。提醒内容可能会发送给您选择的 AI 服务以生成回答。 / Kelivo needs reminders access so it can query, create, and complete reminders after you confirm. Reminder content may be sent to the AI provider you selected to generate answers.

Kelivo 需要访问提醒事项，以便在您确认后查询、创建和完成提醒。提醒内容可能会发送给您选择的 AI 服务以生成回答。 / Kelivo needs reminders access so it can query, create, and complete reminders after you confirm. Reminder content may be sent to the AI provider you selected to generate answers.

Kelivo 需要访问日历，以便 AI 助手在您授权后查询和创建日程；数据仅在设备上处理，我们不会收集这些信息。 / Kelivo needs calendar access so the AI assistant can query and create events when you enable the calendar tools; data is processed on-device and Kelivo does not collect this information.

Kelivo 需要访问日历，以便 AI 助手在您授权后查询和创建日程；数据仅在设备上处理，我们不会收集这些信息。 / Kelivo needs calendar access so the AI assistant can query and create events when you enable the calendar tools; data is processed on-device and Kelivo does not collect this information.
Kelivo 需要使用相机拍摄照片，以便您将图片发送给 AI 助手进行分析。您可以选择是否上传照片。 / Kelivo uses the camera to capture photos that you can share with AI assistants for analysis. Your photo may be uploaded by your choice.
Kelivo 使用麦克风录制您主动提交的语音并转换为文字；我们不会收集这些信息。 / Kelivo uses the microphone to record audio you choose to submit for transcription; Kelivo does not collect this information.

Kelivo 使用系统语音识别将您主动录制的语音转换为文字。您的数据由系统处理；我们不会收集这些信息。 / Kelivo uses system speech recognition to turn audio you choose to record into text. Your data is processed by the system; Kelivo does not collect this information.
Kelivo 需要获取您的地理位置以提供定位与逆地理编码地址解析服务。 / Kelivo needs your location to provide GPS coordinates and reverse geocoding address conversion.
Kelivo 需要使用蓝牙以扫描附近的 BLE 设备并进行数据交互。 / Kelivo uses Bluetooth to scan and communicate with nearby BLE devices.
Kelivo 需要使用蓝牙与您的 BLE 设备建立连接并传输数据。 / Kelivo uses Bluetooth to connect and transfer data with your BLE peripherals.
Kelivo 需要读取您的 HealthKit 健康数据（步数、心率、睡眠、体征等）以提供健康分析与建议。 / Kelivo needs to read your HealthKit data (steps, heart rate, sleep, body metrics) for health insights.
Kelivo 需要向您的 HealthKit 写入健康记录（如步数、体重、饮水等）。 / Kelivo needs to log health records (steps, weight, water) into your HealthKit.
Kelivo 需要访问您的日历以查看、管理和为您添加日程提醒。 / Kelivo needs access to your calendar to view, manage, and create events.
Kelivo 需要日历完全访问权限以帮助您搜索和管理日程安排。 / Kelivo needs full calendar access to search and manage your schedule.
Kelivo 需要访问您的提醒事项以为您创建、管理和查看任务清单。 / Kelivo needs access to your reminders to create, manage, and view task lists.
Kelivo 需要提醒事项完全访问权限以管理您的日常待办事项。 / Kelivo needs full access to reminders to manage your to-do items.
Kelivo 需要闹钟与计时器权限，以便您能够设置闹钟并在指定时间为您播报提醒。 / Kelivo uses AlarmKit so you can schedule alarms and timers to receive timely voice reminders.
允许保存图片到相册，您的数据将保存在本地。/ Allow saving images to your photo library.Your data will be saved locally.
允许访问相册以选择头像图片 / Allow access to your photos to pick an avatar.
